units.rawText: Phew... Professor, you really need to rest more and cut back on the caffeine. Even operand-fabricated caffeine has real effects on your neurons. That concludes the check-up. Thank you for coming in, Professor.

units.rawText: Thank you, Bonee. You've really taken on the role of the Oasis's top attending physician, and keep getting better every day. Thank you again for your efforts at the med bay—it must've been especially taxing lately.

units.rawText: Eh-hehe... I couldn't do it without your support, Professor. Your constant encouragement is what fuels me to keep doing my job...

units.rawText: Professor, do you remember? At first, Persicaria initially opposed me joining the Medical Team. She feared exposing me to the cruelty of war, worried that my neural cloud might not withstand the strain.

units.rawText: Though in honesty, I've experienced the cruelty she refers to when I was out there... I was powerless, only to be able to watch innocent agents fall prey to the Sanctifiers. All I could do was to hide myself underneath the ruins.

units.rawText: When I first arrived at the Oasis, I wasn't sure if I could do well in this role. But I don't want to experience that powerlessness again where I could only be a bystander... Though, the words Persicaria said worried me to no end... I could tell Persicaria did it for my own good, which is why I've been torn between taking action and giving up.
